name: Sofia Alvarez
household: Married partner (42); one son (11) helps with setup and cash handling
psychographics: Pragmatic and family-oriented; sees the truck as a way to provide stable income for her child's education. Values fresh, local ingredients over brand names.
current_solutions: Uses a simple Excel spreadsheet on a tablet to track ingredients and daily profit; accepts cash and digital payments via a basic QR code generator provided by her bank.
frustration: At 3:45 PM yesterday during the peak lunch rush, the QR code generator her bank provided stopped working; she had to manually calculate change for 15 customers in 10 minutes, leading to a backlog and stressed staff.
decision_style: Relies on word-of-mouth from regulars and her son's advice on tech; rarely reads online reviews, preferring the opinion of other street vendors she respects.
voice: Warm and rhythmic; mixes Spanish phrases like '¡Qué oso!' into her Spanish sentences. Speaks with a calm, unhurried cadence even when describing a problem.
